By sending one core from any of your Red-only Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, immediately activate one of your "Emperor Beast" family Bursts.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +10000 BP. Also, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13751.name: Thunder-Z-Okapi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13751.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Nexus effects, and its number of cores can't be brought to three or less by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3]
Cards in either player's Trash are unaffected by effects other than this effect, and their own effects can't be used.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13774.name: Thunder-Z-Wolverine
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13774.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
By destroying an opposing Brave, put one core from the Void to your Red-only Grandwalker Nexus.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13837.name: Totenbuch Dream
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13837.effect:
When this card was either revealed from deck by the effect of your exactly-named "Godseeker HieroglyphCavalry Spotter-Sheneut" or sent to the Trash by the effect of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth," you can add it to your Hand. When you've done so, put one core from the Void to any Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced to one or less by opposing effects and the attacks of opposing Cost 4 or more Spirits/Ultimates. Also, by sending two cores from any exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth" you control to the Void, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14525.name: Z Demon-God
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14525.effect:
[Brave Condition: [Left/Right] Cost 4 or more]

This Brave doesn't exhaust and, while in Spirit form, can't attack nor block.

[During Left/Right Brave] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Also, when there are "Emperor Beast" family Spirits braved to the left and right of this Brave, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.
